SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM store_sales 
JOIN (SELECT * FROM time_dim WHERE t_hour = 8 AND t_minute >= 30) AS time_dim 
ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = time_dim.t_time_sk 
JOIN (SELECT * FROM household_demographics WHERE hd_dep_count = 0) AS household_demographics 
ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = household_demographics.hd_demo_sk 
JOIN store 
ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk 
WHERE store.s_store_name = 'ese' 
ORDER BY COUNT(*) 
LIMIT 100
